| Check | Accept |
|:--|:--|
| Standard curve efficiency | 90–110% (slope −3.6 to −3.1) |
| Standard curve R² | ≥ 0.99 |
| ΔCt between consecutive standards | c. 3.3 (3.1–3.6) |
| Replicate Ct SD | ≤ 0.2–0.3; omit a clear outlier |
| NTC | Undetermined |
| ΔCt between 1:10 000 and 1:20 000 | c. 1.0 (0.8–1.2) |
| Sample Ct | Within the Ct range of Standards 1–6 |
| Melt curve | Single peak, no primer-dimer peak |
